about: Videos and talks to watch later. In YouTube or Safari, press Share, choose Routine Run, then To watch, and each link becomes a step that opens it. It never closes, and it waits when it is empty.
name: To watch

steps.about: Anywhere there is a Share button: press it, choose Routine Run, then To watch. It arrives as a step, after whatever is waiting. Press Next when you have tried it.
steps.title: Send the first one here
